referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official Morris-Jenkins home services homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with a deep-blue campaign poster places a uniformed technician beside a bold home-comfort promise and yellow schedule control. It uses compact two-tier blue-and-white navigation with service categories and a high-contrast schedule pill. The visual system relies on heavy rounded sans statements with compact explanatory sans; surfaces include deep blue, pale blue gray, white and accents include bright yellow, sky blue. Imagery is friendly uniformed technician photography and household-service scenes. The page then runs through service navigation, technician campaign hero, three service category tiles, person-led reassurance, practical benefit cards, customer reviews, articles and contact footer. Its service presentation is large blue service tiles with yellow borders and unmistakable pictograms. Mobile changes to keep the technician and promise together, stack service tiles, and place schedule and phone actions before longer benefits. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy the mascot, uniform, slogan, exact color blocking, employee identity, review text, or service promises.
